abilitygroupdescription.p: These abilities describe miscellaneous Challenges or Hazards that the PCs might have to face.

abilitycheck.name: Acidic Vapor Check
abilitycheck.precondition: Triggered at the end of a round if any character is in a square that contains acidic vapours.
abilitycheck.any-fail: If the character is not in a square containing Acidic Vapours then decrement the Stage.
abilitycheck.critfail: Decrement the Stage twice or once if in a square containing Acidic Vapours.

stage.name: Very Mild
stage.description: Make a Willpower or Endurance check or cough loudly unless holding their breath.

stage.name: Mild
stage.description: Coughing and shortness of breath, make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage.

stage.name: Medium
stage.description: Coughing and Eye irritation make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage. Burning skin suffer 3 health each round.

stage.name: Severe
stage.description: Coughing and Eye irritation make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage. Burning skin suffer 6 health each round.

abilitydescription.p: Exposure to acidic gases like Chlorine Gas or .
The character wishes to perform a Feat of Strength, such as bending bars, lifting gates, or moving or carrying very heavy objects.

abilitycheck.name: Opposed
abilitycheck.fail: Check again next round with disadvantage.

stage.name: Dyspnea
stage.description: Blood pressure rises, and a lack of oxygen to the brain can cause dizziness, confusion, bluish skin discoloration, and involuntary muscle twitching or convulsions. Make all checks at disadvantage. If the character can breath during their round they lose the Asphyixiating aspect. Make a Mettle check at the end of each turn, and progress to the next stage of this condition on failure.

stage.name: Unconsciousness Death
stage.description: The character gains the Unconscious and Dying conditions and cannot lose them until they can breath again. They cannot reduce their stage in these conditions while asphixiating. They can only increase their stages or remain at their current stage.

abilitydescription.p: This ability is the condition that characters get when they are drowning, suffocating, or being choked. Characters are immune to asphyxiation while Holding Their Breath, but they cannot start to Hold Their Breath while being Asphyxiated.
